entry.title: STUDIO424 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release of STUDIO424, an early-90s cassette four-track mixer channel in a pedal, for MPC standalone. **What it does** - Trim into a gently saturating preamp: clean at the defaults, thicker and grittier as you push it. - Two-band shelving EQ: High at 10 kHz and Low at 100 Hz, ±10 dB each. - Channel level into a driveable mix bus, then a Master fader.
